statements.statement: The service was denied with reason code CO-197
The service code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)

statements.basis: denial_letter - states 'required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to service delivery'
statements.statement: The denial was for missing required prior authorization
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
There was concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmic or tachyarrhythmic activity
